Score Up!

nodes.text: Oooh! That's kinda fun!

nodes.text: She reaches under Kevincible's chestplate...

Kimi hands her mother a bowl of ginger cut up into matchsticks.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Tssk. Another one? You can't make any money acting! There's no future!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Plus, everyone has to look at you in those spotlights. Bright light makes your hair look greasy.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks for the confidence boost, Mom.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Anyway, I'll have to, uh, rehearse that night.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Tssk.
Mrs. Chen whips together a quick sauce.

nodes.speaker: Lily
nodes.text: It's okay, Mom. I don't mind if Kimi misses my recital.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Fine. I don't like it. But what do I know?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Probably not the right tact, but at least I'm in the clear.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Tssk. Robot gang? You don't care about robots! And they don't make any money!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Plus, you'll never get married making robots. No man ever says, 'I want a girl that makes robots!'

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Who said anything about getting married?!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: No one. That's my point.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks for the confidence boost, Mom.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Anyway, I'll have to, uh, stay late with the club that night.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Tssk.
Mrs. Chen whips together a quick sauce.

nodes.speaker: Lily
nodes.text: It's okay, Mom. I don't mind if Kimi misses my recital.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Fine. I don't like it. But what do I know?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Probably not the right tact, but at least I'm in the clear.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Computers? Not that robot gang?
Kimi and Lily chuckle.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, this is different from the Robotics Club. This is more like a class.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Oh. It's good to go into computers. Your cousin makes a lot of money because he knows computers.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I know, Mom.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So...
Mrs. Chen whips together a quick sauce.

nodes.speaker: Lily
nodes.text: It's okay, Mom. I don't mind if Kimi misses my recital.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Fine.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's probably the best answer I could have hoped for!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: It's not a problem at all...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Not a problem?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Actually, this is perfect!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah, this Friday I was going to play this new video game I got called Edgeworlds 2!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And this is perfect... Because?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Because now we can play it together!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So... Us going out means... Playing video games `in?`
nodes.text_bbcode: So... Us going out means... Playing video games [color=#3b78e2][i]in?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Cough! Cough! Take what you can get! Cough!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Er... Sounds great, Kevin! This Friday it is!
Kimi practically runs away to prevent Kevin from changing his mind...
After, she meets up with Owen in the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It worked! I've got a date... Sort of... With Kevin!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I finally see why you've been so confused...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Right? I'm not crazy?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not at all. Listen, there's one last bit of advice I wanted to give you.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ooh, a bonus!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Even if things don't work out how you want them to, the right guy will go out of his way to make you feel good when you're down...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks! I'll remember that! In the meantime...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...I've got a date with Kevin this Friday!
Kimi's excitement suddenly dissipates!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: My sister's having a piano recital that night!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You can't skip it?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You don't understand. My sister's piano recitals are like family dinners. You `don't` miss them!
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't understand. My sister's piano recitals are like family dinners. You [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] miss them!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are you going to do?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ugh... The worst thing ever.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Plead with my mother...
That evening, at the Chen house...
Kimi is helping her mother prepare dinner. Her sister is sitting at the table, studying piano sheet music.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: I need an egg.
Kimi opens the fridge, takes out an egg, and hands it to her mother.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So... I think I'm going to have to miss Lily's piano recital...

nodes.speaker: Lily
nodes.text: Aww... Really?

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Why? Why would you do this to your sister?
Mrs. Chen cracks the egg with one hand, pouring it into a bowl perfectly.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm not `doing` anything to her. I just have something else going on.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not [color=#3b78e2][i]doing[/i][/color] anything to her. I just have something else going on.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: I need half a cup of ginger. Cut into matchsticks.
Kimi rummages through the pantry for the ginger.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Well, what do you have going on? What's more important than your sister?

nodes.speaker: Lily
nodes.text: Is it Kevin?
Kimi shoots Lily a quick glance, nodding `'YES'` emphatically before her mother sees.
nodes.text_bbcode: Kimi shoots Lily a quick glance, nodding [b]'YES'[/b] emphatically before her mother sees.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Lily! Don't be silly! It's for... School.
Kimi turns and starts peeling the ginger, while her mother deftly slices up a chicken breast.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: School? You're not in trouble, are you? We can get you a tutor. You know that your cousin runs a tutoring service!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm not in trouble, Mom.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chen
nodes.text: Okay, so you're not in trouble. What is it then?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: What? You do?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh. My. Gosh. I can't believe I just said that!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm so embarrassed!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh...
Kimi buries her head in her arms.
It's that moment when a normal guy might come over and comfort her...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah. Urp. I've got studying... Or something.
Kevin awkwardly steps away, leaving Kimi alone with her embarrassment...
She flees the library, knowing things with Kevin will never develop, knowing that...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Date? Like a date-date?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, like a date-date!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You're asking me out?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yes... I know that's a little forward, but...
Kimi freezes under the pressure!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Kimi? You okay? You look like you just got hit by Dex's super frost wave in real life.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I've... I've got feelings for you!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh... Uh, about that whole 'friends' thing...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh huh.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Time to tell him `exactly` what I want.
nodes.text_bbcode: Time to tell him [color=#3b78e2][i]exactly[/i][/color] what I want.

options.label: I want to go out on a date with you!

nodes.text: Kimi reaches out and touches Kevin on the arm. He smiles immediately.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Owen was right!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Could you help me with it? I'm, like, totally positive you understand it better than I do.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Of course I can help! What are friends for?
Kimi reaches out to touch Kevin's face!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: What... What are you doing?
Kevin leans away from Kimi's hand.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... You've got an eyelash?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Oh, I'll... I'll get it.
Kevin brushes at his cheek for an eyelash that isn't there.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Did I get it?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yep! All good.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Thanks! Only a good friend would point something like that out!
Kimi sticks out her hand, but can't decide where to put it!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Kimi? You okay? Is this a new dance move or something?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, um...
Kimi reaches out, putting her hand on Kevin's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey, Kevin!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: `Yahhhhh! Library ghost!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yahhhhh! Library ghost![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Kevin leaps out of his seat, sending his notebook flying through the air!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whoops!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Don't do that!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, step one was to separate him from the pack... Not give him a heart attack...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Can I talk to you for a moment?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah, just as soon as I stop shaking.
After a moment, Kimi pulls Kevin aside.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I think I'll skip the touching part and just move to step three...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: What'd you want to talk about?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Actually, um, I wanted to talk about us being friends and all.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ahem, Kevin?
Kevin turns around in his seat.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Hey, Kimi! Did you have a good time playing Ogres 'N' Elves today?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sort of.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Eh, don't worry about Dex, the Wise and Purple. He'll grow on you.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Anyway, want to study with us? There are plenty of empty seats!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Actually, could I talk to you for a sec?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Sure!
Kimi pulls Kevin aside.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Step one: done!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Step one was to... What was it?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, whatever, I'll just touch him!
After school, Kimi and Owen meet up near the entrance to the library.
At a row of tables across the way, Kevin is studying quietly with some of the other nerds.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So... What's your advice?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Well, what is it that you want exactly?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I just want to go on a date with him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, great, so--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And we're slow dancing...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: On a beach. With a billion stars overhead. I rest my head against his strong shoulder, and that's when he tells me--

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Kimi, you're standing uncomfortably close to me.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Oh right!
Kimi takes a step back.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I need you to focus for a second. You're okay with asking Kevin out?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Not my preference, but I'll take what I can get.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The first thing you're going to have to do is separate him from his friends.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You think that matters?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, nerd culture is weird. If you ask him out in a group, he could get made fun of and lose standing.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I hope my reputation hasn't fallen `that` much.
nodes.text_bbcode: I hope my reputation hasn't fallen [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] much.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. It's a compliment. The cooler you are, the more he'll be made fun of.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wow, okay... First tip: separate the nerd from the pack. This is like hunting!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. The second tip is going to sound a little weird...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The second tip is to touch him.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Would it be wrong for me to say that I like the sound of this step?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A little. Look, I'm not saying grope him or anything, just... Touch him in a way that says 'I'm interested in you.'

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Guys `love` this.
nodes.text_bbcode: Guys [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] this.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Touch, but don't creep. Got it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Last, it seems obvious, but tell him `exactly` what you want.
nodes.text_bbcode: Last, it seems obvious, but tell him [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] what you want.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You mean, that I like him?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What you want isn't for him to know that you like him. What you want is to go out on a date with him.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, but if I say I like him then it will lead to--
Owen raises his hand, silencing Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There's no 'leading to anything' in the guy world. Especially the `nerd` guy world.
nodes.text_bbcode: There's no 'leading to anything' in the guy world. Especially the [color=#e23b3b][i]nerd[/i][/color] guy world.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So... That's it then? No more tips?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yep, that's it! I'll be sitting right at that table next to the nerds. And if it comes to it, I'll try and help you out, okay?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks, Owen!
A few moments later...
Owen is sitting near the nerds. Kimi walks up and approaches Kevin from behind...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: All right, the first tip Owen gave me was to...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're really trying to make Powen happen, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's already happening!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't really see how me and Paige makes you certain I can help you...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Because nobody goes through `all` the intense drama that you two have been through without picking up `some` tips!
nodes.text_bbcode: Because nobody goes through [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] the intense drama that you two have been through without picking up [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] tips!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh. Yeah, I guess I have learned a lot since we first met. Mostly about how completely out of touch rich people are...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So, you'll help me then?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well... I think I'd feel like a monster if I didn't... So, sure!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eeep! Okay, okay! Meet me at the library after school!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And if you've been asked out before that means you do know a thing or two about asking guys out!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, that logic makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I know it does because I'm a logic genius!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I've never actually been asked out before.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What? Really?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm kind of surprised you didn't know that... Since you spookily know `everything` about me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I'm kind of surprised you didn't know that... Since you spookily know [color=#e23b3b][i]everything[/i][/color] about me.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I must be slipping...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Look, I really need to get to class, so just whatever thing has to happen for me to do that, let's do that thing.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You'll help me? Great!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Meet me at the library after school!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: With the orc defeated and `most` of the team fending off the remaining horde, Chenergy can now administer the healing spell.
nodes.text_bbcode: With the orc defeated and [color=#e23b3b][i]most[/i][/color] of the team fending off the remaining horde, Chenergy can now administer the healing spell.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And get back to Kevin's chest! Er... For healing purposes!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And get back to Kevin's chest! Er... Plate. Chestplate.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: As Chenergy kneels down, she is reminded by an unseen and rather handsome force that there is a small chance her spell will overwhelm Kevincible the Great...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Really? Instead of using my `sword,` you decided to punch the orc in the face?
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? Instead of using my [color=#e23b3b][i]sword,[/i][/color] you decided to punch the orc in the face?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Chenergy punches the orc in the nose... And notices with surprise that the orc reels back in tremendous pain, exploding in a ball of brilliant light!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: What.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It turns out that Chenergy's healing spell `also` causes huge damage against orcs!
nodes.text_bbcode: It turns out that Chenergy's healing spell [color=#e23b3b][i]also[/i][/color] causes huge damage against orcs!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: In your face! Literally!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Well... That was... Hrrk... Surprising.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Chenergy tries to use Kevincible's sword...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Tries?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...But it's too heavy!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Oh, yeah. Hrrk. Duh.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The orc's mace comes hurtling down at Chenergy.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Tssk. Fine. I'll spare a throwing dagger.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: At the last second, Ashley fells the orc with a throwing dagger to the back!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks, Ash Cash...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Seriously, do not mention it again, weakling.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No time!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'll use Kevin's sword!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... Destructum... Clotus... Er, dissecto?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh oh.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You just recited the words of incineration!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh no! Did I just incinerate Kevin's character?!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: What?! Hrrk! What?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Luckily, the spell only affected Kevincible's chestplate and not Kevincible himself.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Phew!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I really liked that armor...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Do you want to try again?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sure.
This time Kimi remembers the words.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Reparum sanguay surrectos!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Having activated her healing spell, Chenergy's hands begin to glow a bright, dazzling white!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: She puts her hands on Kevincible's now exposed chest...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Chenergy kneels over Kevincible the Great, preparing to cast her healing spell...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Which of you will protect her?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Erik the Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Are you kidding? It's been far too long since my Giant's club tossed puny orc bodies around!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Nicely phrased. Ash Cash?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Well, I'm feeling pretty comfortable over here. Still, I believe I'm in range to toss in some throwing daggers.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Provided I can `see` my targets.
nodes.text_bbcode: Provided I can [color=#3b78e2][i]see[/i][/color] my targets.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I `said` I was sorry!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]said[/i][/color] I was sorry!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How very in-character. Dex, the Wise and Purple?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'll let the Giant and the Thief handle this. I'd like to restore my mana away from the battlefield.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Looks like Dex is up to something... I'd like to--

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Too late!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The orcs are recovering from Chenergy's Blinding Light spell! And now...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The orc horde is upon you! As Chenergy kneels over Kevincible, Erik the Erik and Ash Cash dispatch the first line of orcs!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! I know what `I'm` eating for breakfast!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha ha! I know what [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] eating for breakfast!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Really? You're going to eat the dead orcs?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What? Ew! I was just thinking about trail mix with `extra` raisins!
nodes.text_bbcode: What? Ew! I was just thinking about trail mix with [color=#e23b3b][i]extra[/i][/color] raisins!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Erik the Erik believes in eating nutritionally, `especially` after a rigorous battle!
nodes.text_bbcode: Erik the Erik believes in eating nutritionally, [color=#e23b3b][i]especially[/i][/color] after a rigorous battle!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So did I heal Kevin yet?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, first you must recite the words of healing...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Reparum sanguay surrectos!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You do know what a Cleric is, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ahem. Dex. Rust monster.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'll shut up now!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Really? You're not going to heal me?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Kevin... Er, Kevincible, but it just seems like we should deal with these orc things first!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I understand... Hrrk!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How would you like to fight the orcs?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Don't I have some spells or something?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You do have Blinding Light...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ooh! I'll cast that!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wait!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Too late! Kimi casts Blinding Light! All the orcs are now temporarily blinded!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Unfortunately, so are all your teammates.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, whoops. Sorry. Uh, close your eyes next time, guys.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Thanks for the tip!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Can I use this time to heal Kevincible?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yep!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Great choice!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks! Might as well do what I'm good at, right?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I'm glad you chose to heal me, Chenergy. Hrrk! I don't think I'm long for this world!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What are friends... Er... Companions for?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What?! Why? Why would being a Cleric mean hanging out with a Thief?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: My character's delicate, and the rock seems safe!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Really? You're not going to heal me?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I will... Just not when there are those orc things everywhere! They seem dangerous!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: She's made her choice. Hehehe.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Why'd you laugh like that?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: No reason.
Chenergy hides behind the rock next to Ash Cash McBrash.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I'd like to take this time to pickpocket Chenergy.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey! I trusted you!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: And I'm rewarding you by making you less encumbered!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Chenergy, Ash Cash just stole half your gold.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, I try to steal it back!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You don't have any pickpocketing skills, and Ash Cash immediately catches your hand.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Can I pickpocket Chenergy again while I'm reprimanding her for being dishonest!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Devilish! Of course!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Sorry, Kimi. It's who I am.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You lost another 100 coins, Chenergy.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Fine! I don't like this rock! I'll go heal Kevincible!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Finally!

nodes.text: And it's featuring none other than fabulous `me!` Finally, it's my turn to be in the spotlight... Literally!

nodes.text: Unable to control herself, Kimi screams at the cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You guys are dumb and stupid and mean!
The cafeteria goes silent. All eyes are on Kimi, whose face is now as red as red can get.
Suddenly, the cheerleaders burst into laughter!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Hahaha! Geez, Kimi, take a breath!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Look at her face! It's redder than Nicole's hair!
Nicole tries to imitate Kimi's voice.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: 'I'm a freshman and I look weird. But you guys are dumb and stupid and dumb! Boohoohoo!'
Kimi flees the cafeteria amid a rising wave of laughter, trying to outrun it, but it seems to follow her...
And she knows she'll never escape it. She knows that...
Kimi stays as calm as possible, finally getting out of hearing range of the cheerleaders.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Phew!
She debates going over to the nerd table...
In the midst of her internal struggle, Kevin looks up and sees her.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Crap...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Hey, Kimi, over here!
She shuffles over and sits down next to him.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, hi.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Don't worry about those cheerleaders, they're just jealous because you're a better dresser than they are.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hee! You really think so?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah, and if I think it, it must be true. I mean, as a nerd, I'm supposed to think that cheerleaders are prettier, right?
Kimi laughs... And tries as hard as she can to keep her smile from spreading across her face.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That means Kevin thinks I'm prettier than they are!
As the nerds debate what game they're about to play, Kimi remembers what Owen said...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: When you're down, the right guy will go out of his way to make you feel better.
She knows things aren't ideal between her and Kevin, but they're good enough...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: For now.
You have reached the end of `Season 6, Episode 3: How to Date a Nerd!`

Even as she hears Lindsay snickering behind her back, Kimi keeps calm.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just don't trip... And `don't` look back!
nodes.text_bbcode: Just don't trip... And [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] look back!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just ignore them, Kimi...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I never realized how goofy Kimi dresses!
Kimi stands up and starts to walk away...
Her hands shaking, Kimi picks up her lunch tray as calmly as she can.
She hears Nicole whisper something to Maria about freshmen and how they have no fashion sense.
Owen looks over his shoulder at the nerds' table, where Kevin sits.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You going to go over there?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Maybe. I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All right. Keep your head up, kid.
Owen leaves.
A few moments later, several of the cheerleaders sit next to Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Remember what we talked about, Maria.
Maria clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: If you're looking for Emily, she's off with her boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I know, I just--

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: And speaking of boyfriends, I think I see yours watching us from over there.
Lindsay points to Kevin.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: He's not really my boy--

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Whatever he is, I think he wants to talk to you.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But I don't--

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Like, now.
And suddenly, Kimi realizes what's going on.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: They're booting me from the Center Table...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just... Just stay calm, get up, and leave.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: If you blow up, they'll giggle about it for weeks, and you'll never live it down.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The best date I've ever had!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why are you lying?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't know. I just don't want to talk about the fact that my date was...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A nerd date?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Pretty much...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? I thought the whole point of this thing was to cut out the confusion!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, I'm apparently not a very good cutter-outer because I still can't tell what Kevin and I are!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sorry, this is probably why you didn't want to talk about this, huh?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah. Duh.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Promising's good. Promising I like.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Still, it was no dream date. It was... A nerd date.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I got that impression.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Of course this happened. Why wouldn't it?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Do you want to play with the guys?
Kimi sighs.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh, is something wrong?
Not wanting to blow any chance she might have with Kevin, Kimi keeps her feelings to herself...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's... It's fine.
Kimi spends the rest of her date playing games online with Kevin and the nerds...
At lunch on Monday, Kimi is sitting at the Center Table with Ben, Emily, $ZOE, and Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... How'd the date go?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Date? Back up. Kimi Chen, did you go on a date without telling me?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It was hardly a date, and I would have told you, but...
She casts a quick glance at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...You've been busier than usual.
The group gets silent for just a moment.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahem. Was your hardly-a-date with Kevin?
Kimi nods.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Don't girls usually gush about their dates? Because I'm going to leap out on a limb here and say you don't want to talk about it.
Kimi smiles, nodding again.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Nailed it.
An alarm goes off on $ZOE's phone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Time to check in on Sam! I gave her some S.E.T. vocab words to study!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is she with Nick? 'Cause I'm betting they're studying something other than their vocabularies!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Everyone gets what I'm saying, right? They're sucking face? Making out?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We get it, sweetie.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And that's the perfect note to leave on... Bye, everyone!
$ZOE leaves. Emily looks to Kimi, as though she's got something on her mind, but Ben speaks before she can say anything...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Speaking of 'studying'... Miss Kessler, would you be interested in, uh, enriching your word power with me?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hee! Sure.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know I'm talking about makin' out again, right?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, Major Subtle, I got it.
Ben and Emily sheepishly leave, giggling.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Looks like it's just the two of us, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: About that...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Let me guess... You have somewhere to be too?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I hate to abandon you, but yes. I'm meeting up with Paige after school for some kind of Monarch Prep event.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was told to 'bring a gift', but I don't know who it's for... So I have to shop. For an anonymous person.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway, before I go, you're sure you don't want to talk about your date with Kevin?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Trust me, it wouldn't be much fun for either of us!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How about a quick summary then? One word to let me know it's not as bad as you're making it out to be.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't want to lie about how my date went, but I don't think Owen really wants the truth...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: One word? It was...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: How am I going to save this date?!
Kevin's phone buzzes. He checks the message and quickly gets up off the couch.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Well, uh... This has been... Fun.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It has?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yup. Good, uh, gaming. I'll see you out.
Kevin starts to lead Kimi out of the den.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Aren't you going to turn off the game console thingy?
A message pops up on the screen...

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: 'Is she gone? 2 vs. 2 in five minutes!'

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's about me, isn't it? Are you going to play more after I leave?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: What? No. I'm--
Kevin yawns.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I'm `really` tired.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] tired.

nodes.text: Kevin continues to move toward the door...
On the front doorstep, Kevin tries to close the door on Kimi, but she stands in the frame, turns, and faces him.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: There's only `one` way I can salvage this date!
nodes.text_bbcode: There's only [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] way I can salvage this date!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I can't have the door open for too long. Allergies.
Kimi leans in close to Kevin... He leans away...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Look... I know you don't have allergies just like I know you're not `actually` tired...
nodes.text_bbcode: Look... I know you don't have allergies just like I know you're not [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] tired...

nodes.text: Closer...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh, I'm serious... I...
Kimi puts a finger to Kevin's lips. She moves in closer.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Shhh. And I know you're going to play again, but I'm okay with that.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Y-Y-You are?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh yeah. Because after this moment, I know you're going to spend the rest of the night trying to focus on your game...
`Closer.` She can feel his breathing.
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Closer.[/b] She can feel his breathing.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Ah...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...When really all you'll be able to think about...
Their lips are about to touch.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Ah...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Is this moment. Right. Here.
Kevin's head whips back!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Ah-choo!
He sprays Kimi's face with a fine layer of mucous-y mist!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ew! Ew ew ew ew ew ew ew ewwwwwwwwwwwwwwwww!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I'm `so` sorry! But I wasn't lying about my allergies!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] sorry! But I wasn't lying about my allergies!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just. Don't. Say. `Anything.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just. Don't. Say. [color=#3b78e2][i]Anything.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Kimi wipes her face off and shuffles out the door. Kevin closes it behind him...
A few seconds later, still reeling from what just happened, Kimi hears the sounds of the video game reverberating through the walls of the house.
Without a doubt, she knows...
A look comes over his face.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I swear, I'm not fishing for compliments or anything, but... Is there something you want to tell me?
Kevin nods.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Kimi... I... I've never said this to anyone...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I really--
A message comes through on the console.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: It's the guys! They're all online!
The screen flashes a brilliant white!
When it clears, the screen just says, `You have failed. Replay from checkpoint?`
nodes.text_bbcode: When it clears, the screen just says, [b]You have failed. Replay from checkpoint?[/b]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Did I do that?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yes. I told you the left trigger was atomic bomb. You just nuked both our characters!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But I got the bat too, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah,  but because we died, we have to start over again.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Which means we'll be fighting that bat again.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Resilient little sucker, isn't he?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I `hate` starting over.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]hate[/i][/color] starting over.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry... I promise it won't happen again.
Kimi makes a mental note to never squeeze the left trigger.
Kimi squeezes the right trigger, slaying the bat!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Awesome! I think this is a sign of good gaming times to come!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Muahaha! That was `so` fun! Bring me more bats to slaughter!
nodes.text_bbcode: Muahaha! That was [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] fun! Bring me more bats to slaughter!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Ha ha! You're so cool!
Kimi hesitates and squeezes a trigger at random!
Kevin hands her a controller.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Ready for this?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: This game shouldn't be that hard, especially if you played Edgeworlds 1!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And if you've never really played very many video games at all? Except for maybe in the library once?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh, well... You should be fine as long as you remember that the right trigger is shoot and the left trigger is atomic bomb.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Got it. That seems like an important distinction.
After a quick tutorial, Kimi's and Kevin's characters set out through a dark cave!
Suddenly a giant vampire bat flies out toward them!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Shoot it!
Kimi squeezes the...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: AWESOME! ONCE YOU PLAY AT THIS VOLUME, YOU NEVER GO BACK!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I BET!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: YOU SWEAT? YOU'RE SWEATY?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: NO! I MEAN... THE SOUND! IT'S GOOD!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I'M MEAN, AND THE SCIENCE COULD?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I LIKE. THE SOUND.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: LIGHTS? OUT?
Suddenly the lights in the house flicker, the stereo makes a popping sound, and a single wisp of smoke trails out of it!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Whoa!
Kevin gets up and quickly unplugs the sound system.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: How'd you know that was going to happen?
Kimi rubs at her ringing ears.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I didn't. Just. Forget about it.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Sure...
Kevin spends the next few minutes making sure all the electronics are still functional. Finally...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Sure! I wouldn't want to destroy your ears!
Kevin turns the sound down a few clicks.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Better?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Much! You're not upset are you?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Please! If I had to choose between loud video games alone or quiet video games with a... With you...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I'd choose you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's really sweet.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Don't put too much thought into it, I'd choose Dex or Brendan too.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh...
Kevin leads Kimi into the den, where a massive entertainment system takes up half the room!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whoa! You guys are serious about entertainment!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: When it comes to sound, I don't mess around!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Check this out...
Kimi and Kevin sit down on the couch, and Kevin powers on the game console.
The sound blasts out from the TV!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Surround sound! Zero distortion! Three structured surface woofers! You can't buy a purer sound!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's... It's loud!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Oh... Do you want me to turn it down?

options.label: Maybe turn it down a little!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Cheaper it is!
Kevin pulls two frozen dinners out of the freezer and sticks one in the microwave.
The whirring of the microwave somehow throws attention on the silence between them...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: So...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! So awkward!
After the longest minutes of her life, their food is ready.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Come with me...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's a video game date, isn't it? Might as well spend as much time playing video games!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I like the way you think, Chen!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It was nothing.
Kevin places a quick order to a nearby pizza place.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: All right! Now we've got extra time to play!
Friday night...
Kimi arrives on the doorstep of Kevin's house wearing a cute flouncy blouse over a bright orange skirt.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Get it together, Kimi. He's the one who should be nervous. He's the big nerd, and you're super cool.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So why am I nervous?
Kimi takes a deep breath and rings the doorbell.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Maybe because I like this guy, and I just want tonight to be... Amazing.
The door swings open, and Kevin is standing there, dressed... How he's always dressed.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Whoa! You look fancy!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Is fancy good or is fancy bad?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Fancy is... Different.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're really sweeping me off my feet, Deluca.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I'm not really trying to.
Kimi sighs.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Anyway, come in.
Kevin leads Kimi into the kitchen...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Grub choice: microwave dinner or pizza delivery?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Keep in mind that pizza delivery buys us a few extra minutes, but microwave dinner is cheaper...
Kimi blushes.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...And is about to place her hands on the wound...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh oh, I don't like the sound of 'about to'.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...When an orc manages to slip through the team's line of defense! The spell is interrupted before Kevincible can be healed!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Impossible!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
